title: Finocchi Gratinati
subtitle: Fennel braised in the oven then finished with a parmesan crumb
excerpt: Fennel bulbs are par-boiled until just tender, layered in a buttered dish, and topped with parmesan and breadcrumbs. They bake until golden and the anise edge softens into something sweet and mild. A good side dish for almost any main.
sourceNotes: Classic Italian vegetable gratin. Synthesised from northern Italian vegetable preparations common to Veneto and Lombardy.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Par-boil the fennel and layer the dish a day ahead. Keep in the fridge. Add the topping just before baking.

content.text: Fennel loses its sharp anise note when it is cooked and becomes mild and buttery. Par-boil it first so the oven time is short. Keep the fronds to scatter on top before serving.
Heat the oven to 200C. Butter a gratin dish generously.
Bring a large saucepan of well-salted water to the boil. Add the fennel quarters and cook for 8 minutes until just tender at the thick end. Drain well in a colander.
Arrange the fennel in a single layer in the prepared dish. Season with salt, pepper, and a grating of nutmeg if using.
Melt the butter with the olive oil in a small pan. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Spoon this over the fennel.
Mix the parmesan and breadcrumbs together. Scatter evenly over the top.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until the top is deep golden and the fennel is fully soft when pierced with a knife.
Rest for 5 minutes. Scatter the reserved fennel fronds over the top and serve from the dish.

items.symptom: The topping browns but the fennel is still firm.
items.cause: The fennel was undercooked in the par-boil stage.
items.fix: Cover with foil and cook for 10 minutes more, then uncover for the last 5 minutes.

items.symptom: The breadcrumb topping is pale and soft.
items.cause: The dish was overcrowded or the oven was not hot enough.
items.fix: Move the dish to the top shelf and switch to the grill setting for 3 to 4 minutes.

items.symptom: The dish is watery at the bottom.
items.cause: The fennel was not drained well enough after par-boiling.
items.fix: Pat the fennel dry with a clean tea towel before layering in the dish next time.
